subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation as the canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those turns always tool-free?
rationale: The remaining choice changes persisted session recovery semantics and an internal tool boundary, which automation should not silently approve even though the patch is coherent.

options.title: Accept and land after lint
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then merge this PR as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

options.title: Change the terminal state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired stored state for aborted delivery-only announce runs, request that state adjustment before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader model
options.body: If maintainers want one recovery model for all inter-session delivery turns, pause this PR and design that owner boundary first.

recommendation.title: Accept and land after lint
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then merge this PR as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart lifecycle and Codex internal-turn commits make this the closest available owner for the session-state/tool-boundary merge choice.
